svg.title: How an Application Load Balancer works
svg.desc: Animated scene: users send requests to an Application Load Balancer, which rotates them across three servers, routes /api and /images to separate target groups, stops sending traffic to a server that fails its health check, and resumes when it recovers.
svg.text: How an Application Load Balancer works

g.text: ① Round-robin: requests rotate across the servers
② Path-based routing: /api and /images go to different target groups
③ Health check fails: the ALB stops sending traffic to Server B
④ Server B recovers: traffic is shared again

svg.text: Requests are shared across healthy servers; the path picks the target group.
